prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning beds/booths or spray (airbrush) tans? Preferences matter — safety and results differ between them.

I can’t look up current local listings in real time, but here’s how to find the best tanning salon in Pleasanton and what to check so you get a safe, even result:

How to find candidates
- Search Google Maps and Yelp for “tanning salon Pleasanton, CA” and sort/filter by rating and recent reviews.  
- Check Instagram/Facebook for before-and-after photos and how they respond to customer questions.  
- Ask neighbors on Nextdoor or local Facebook groups for personal recommendations.

What to look for (UV tanning)
- Clean, well-maintained equipment and fresh bed liners.  
- Staff who ask about skin type, tanning history and medication (photosensitizing meds).  
- Modern beds with known brand names and timer safeguards.  
- Transparent pricing, single-session options or day passes so you can test once.  
- Good reviews referencing consistent, even tans and professional staff.

What to look for (spray tan)
- Technicians who do a patch test or ask about allergies, and who match solution shade to your skin tone.  
- Brands listed (e.g., Versa, Mystic, Norvell are common reputable lines).  
- Clear before-care and after-care instructions and visible before/after photos.  
- Positive reviews praising natural-looking results and minimal streaking.

Safety & red flags
- Red flag: staff pressure to frequent or long sessions, dirty facility, or unclear equipment maintenance.  
- Ask about ventilation for spray tans and salon hygiene routines.  
- For UV tanning, remember the skin-cancer risk; consider spray tanning or topical bronzers as safer alternatives.

If you want, tell me whether you prefer UV or spray tan and I’ll give a tailored checklist and suggested questions to call prospective salons. If you’d like, paste 2–3 salon names you find and I can help compare them based on the reviews/descriptions you give.
